items.informal_name: Equivalence between polynomials with restricted support and coefficient functions
items.type:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  {κ : Type u_2} →
    {R : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq κ] →
        [inst : CommRing R] →
          [DecidableEq R] →
            (monoms : ι → Finset (κ →₀ ℕ)) → { p // ∀ (i : ι), (p i).support ⊆ monoms i } ≃ ((i : ι) × ↥(monoms i) → R)
items.informal_description: An equivalence between the type of families of multivariate polynomials whose supports are contained in specified finite sets of monomials and the type of functions on the union of these monomials. This equivalence maps each polynomial to its coefficient function restricted to the given monomials, and reconstructs polynomials from coefficient functions by setting coefficients outside the specified monomials to zero. The equivalence preserves the bijection between polynomials and their coefficients within the constrained monomial sets.

items.informal_name: Indicator Polynomial for a Point in Multivariate Polynomial Ring
items.type: {K : Type u_1} → {σ : Type u_2} → [Fintype K] → [Fintype σ] → [inst : CommRing K] → (σ → K) → MvPolynomial σ K
items.informal_description: Given a finite type $\sigma$ and a commutative ring $K$, the indicator polynomial for a point $a : \sigma \to K$ is defined as the product over all $n \in \sigma$ of $1 - (X_n - C(a_n))^{\#K - 1}$, where $X_n$ denotes the variable corresponding to $n$, $C(a_n)$ is the constant polynomial for $a_n$, and $\#K$ is the cardinality of $K$. This polynomial evaluates to 1 at the point $a$ and 0 at all other points in $K^{\sigma}$.

items.informal_name: Cardinality of Support Equals n iff Polynomial is Sum of n Terms with Distinct Exponents
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {f : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ},
  f.support.card = n ↔
    ∃ k x, ∃ (_ : StrictMono k) (_ : ∀ (i : Fin n), x i ≠ 0), f = ∑ i, Polynomial.C (x i) * Polynomial.X ^ k i
items.informal_description: The cardinality of the support of a polynomial $ f $ is equal to $ n $ if and only if there exist a strictly increasing function $ k : \mathrm{Fin}(n) \to \mathbb{N} $, a function $ x : \mathrm{Fin}(n) \to R $ with $ x(i) \neq 0 $ for all $ i $, such that $ f = \sum_{i} C(x(i)) \cdot X^{k(i)} $.

items.informal_name: Submodule of Multivariate Polynomials with Exponents Bounded by Field Cardinality Minus One
items.type: Type u → (K : Type u) → [Fintype K] → [CommRing K] → Type u
items.informal_description: For a finite commutative ring $ K $ and a type $ \sigma $, this is the submodule of the multivariate polynomial ring $ K[\sigma] $ consisting of all polynomials where each exponent in every variable is at most $ \#K - 1 $. This submodule contains polynomials whose support (nonzero exponents) is restricted to exponent vectors bounded by $ \#K - 1 $ in each coordinate, and it is closed under addition and scalar multiplication.
A predicate indicating that a function assigning integer coefficients to exponent vectors (functions from $\alpha$ to $\mathbb{N}$) has finite support, i.e., is a polynomial.

items.informal_name: Finite Range of Coefficients in Polynomials
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R), (Set.range f.coeff).Finite
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ f $ over a semiring $ R $, the range of its coefficient function is a finite set.
